Embossed old metal texture, warm bone-ivory worn highlights and tarnished ochre edges, rough engraved oil-paint grain, dark recesses, directional upper-left light. Restrained elegant narrow frame like an antique gothic fantasy portrait surround. Sculptural painterly realism, NOT shiny gold or plastic, no gemstones, skulls, faces, lettering, UI symbols, watermark, perspective, drop shadow outside canvas, or extra frames. One frame only. Production border-image asset, decorative corners are the focus.
notes: Frame uses CSS nine-slice at 22%, without filling the center.
